rank_math_title: Rwanda Golf and Gorilla Safari: 5 Wonderful Days of Luxury
rank_math_desc: Rwanda golf and gorilla safari: play 18 holes at Kigali Golf Resort, then trek mountain gorillas from a luxury lodge. Permit and green fees included.
post_content: This Rwanda golf and gorilla safari pairs a round at Kigali Golf Resort with a luxury stay and an unforgettable mountain gorilla trek.
overview:
A Rwanda golf and gorilla safari is a rare mix: a round on an 18-hole course in Kigali, and a once-in-a-lifetime hour with mountain gorillas in Volcanoes National Park, all in five relaxed days.

You stay in luxury hotels and lodges, travel in a private 4x4 with your own driver guide, and enjoy time to unwind between the highlights.

Why choose a Rwanda golf and gorilla safari?

Kigali is one of Africa's cleanest and safest capitals, and Kigali Golf Resort sits right in the city, with rolling fairways and views over the hills. Volcanoes National Park is only about 2.5 hours away, so it is easy to combine both.

This trip suits golfers who want more than a golf holiday, couples where one partner plays, and business travellers adding a short break.

  • Golf: green fees, rental clubs and a cart included.
  • Gorillas: one gorilla permit per person included.
  • Luxury: top hotels in Kigali and a premium lodge in Musanze.

What to expect on your Rwanda golf and gorilla safari

On day one you are met at Kigali International Airport and taken to your hotel to settle in. Day two is golf day, with a morning round at Kigali Golf Resort and lunch at the clubhouse.

On day three you visit the Kigali Genocide Memorial, then drive north to Musanze. In the afternoon you may visit the Ellen DeGeneres Campus of the Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund to learn about gorilla research.

Day four is the highlight. You trek through bamboo and montane forest to a habituated gorilla family and spend one unforgettable hour with them. Day five is a relaxed drive back to Kigali for your flight.

How fit do you need to be?

Gorilla treks can take one to six hours on steep, muddy ground. Rangers match groups to families by fitness, and porters can carry your bag and help you along.

Best time for golf and gorillas in Rwanda

Both activities run all year. June to September and December to February are drier, which means firmer fairways and easier trails. Gorilla permits are limited each day, so book early.

Read our guide to gorilla trekking in Rwanda or see our luxury gorilla trekking Rwanda safari for a trip focused on the lodges. Park information is on Visit Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park page.

How much does the Rwanda golf and gorilla safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888, email bookings@divulgeadventures.com or send the enquiry form on this page, and we will share a detailed quote for your dates.

faq.q: Can you play golf in Rwanda?
faq.a: Yes. Kigali Golf Resort has a modern 18-hole course in the heart of Kigali, popular with visitors and residents alike.

faq.q: Can I combine golf and gorilla trekking in one trip?
faq.a: Yes. Kigali's golf course and Volcanoes National Park are only about 2.5 hours apart, making it easy to combine both in five days.

faq.q: Do I need to bring my own golf clubs?
faq.a: No. Rental clubs and a golf cart are included, though you are welcome to bring your own clubs.

faq.q: What luxury lodges are near Volcanoes National Park?
faq.a: Popular luxury choices include Virunga Lodge, Bisate Lodge, The Bishop's House, Singita Kwitonda and One&Only Gorilla's Nest.

faq.q: Can non-golfers join a Rwanda golf and gorilla safari?
faq.a: Yes. While one partner plays, the other can enjoy a spa, a city tour, art galleries or Kigali's markets and cafés.

faq.q: How much is a gorilla permit in Rwanda?
faq.a: A gorilla trekking permit costs USD 1,500 per person per trek, and one permit is included in this package.

faq.q: Can I play a second round of golf?
faq.a: Yes. A second round can be arranged on day two or another free afternoon. Caddie fees and extra rounds are paid separately.
